name: shelf
description: The shelf skills — manage a personal shelf documentation library through the `shelf` CLI (add, find, edit, remove, audit, open, and set up documents), and research a resource link into an original HTML reference page. Two skills (shelf for library management, shelf-reference for reference authoring) with progressive disclosure; they shell out to the CLI and never edit library files directly. Ships in the shelf repo for Claude Code and Codex.
